summary: The first stable Wombat release helps Codex users review local usage and configuration, act on evidence-backed findings, and verify the result.
highlights: Review token usage, API cost estimates, tasks, turns, and timing from local Codex records.
Inspect AGENTS.md, Skills, MCP entries, and Hooks, then send selected findings to a compatible local Codex and recheck them.
Run wombat doctor for a read-only, offline check of the installation, PATH, bundled runtime, local core, and Codex data directory.
Install and open self-contained archives with one command, then use atomic, checksum-verified updates without a system Node.js, npm, Rust, pnpm, or compiler installation.
knownLimitations: Codex is the only production data source in this release; support for other agents is planned.
API costs are estimates. Unpriced or partial data stays explicit and is separate from subscription allowance.
Large first reads can take time. Project-level progress and per-project retry remain planned.
Optimization findings can remain unknown when runtime or history evidence is incomplete. A passed file check does not prove lower token usage.
Native handoff requires a compatible local Codex installation. Wombat currently provides local Web and CLI interfaces.
